description: Free to call. What this caller (its key, or its address without one) may still spend: units left this minute and today, what each tool costs, how many plans may run at once, and whether LoomDesk's node is busy right now. Without a key, every caller at the same address shares one quota: a free key (POST https://loomdesk.trade/api/agent/key, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or add `?key=<key>` to the MCP URL) gives an agent its own.
name: agent_quota
title: This caller's quota
